segments.text: Up next, biological incidents.
segments.zh: 接下来是生物事件。

segments.text: When you're dealing with pathogens or biological toxins, things get serious in a hurry.
segments.zh: 当你处理病原体或生物毒素时，事情很快就会变得严重。

segments.text: If there's an exposure, you don't have the luxury of taking your time.
segments.zh: 如果发生暴露，你没有慢慢来的余地。

segments.text: You need to act fast.
segments.zh: 你需要迅速行动。

segments.text: So let's say there's a spill.
segments.zh: 假设发生了洒漏。

segments.text: Your first move has to be containment.
segments.zh: 你的第一步必须是控制。

segments.text: That means laying down biohazard tape, getting anyone who doesn't need to be there out
segments.zh: 这意味着拉上生物危害警示带，让任何不需要在场的人离开

segments.text: of the area, and if it's airborne, using biological safety cabinets.
segments.zh: 该区域，如果是经空气传播的，就使用生物安全柜。

segments.text: The goal is simple.
segments.zh: 目标很简单。

segments.text: To keep the danger contained so it doesn't spread and create an even bigger p-
segments.zh: 把危险控制住，让它不会扩散，造成更大的麻——

segments.text: It's time to clean up.
segments.zh: 该清理了。

segments.text: This is where you don't want to cut corners.
segments.zh: 这时候你可不能偷工减料。

segments.text: Use the right disinfectants to make sure whatever you're dealing with is gone for good.
segments.zh: 要使用合适的消毒剂，确保你所处理的东西被彻底清除。

segments.text: If any equipment has to be contained, get it autoclaved so it's fully sterile.
segments.zh: 如果有任何设备需要去污，就把它进行高压灭菌，使其完全无菌。

segments.text: No half measures here.
segments.zh: 这里不能敷衍了事。

segments.text: Now, if someone's exposed, say a needle stick happens with a potentially infected blood,
segments.zh: 现在，如果有人发生暴露，比如被可能带有感染性血液的针头扎伤，

segments.text: immediate action is crucial.
segments.zh: 立即采取行动至关重要。

segments.text: You've got to wash the area with soap and water right away, no waiting around.
segments.zh: 你必须马上用肥皂和水清洗该部位，不能耽搁。

segments.text: After that, follow up with medical attention.
segments.zh: 之后，接着就医。

segments.text: Document what happened, and make sure you're getting the right treatment.
segments.zh: 记录发生了什么，并确保你得到正确的治疗。

segments.text: If post-exposure prophylaxis, PP, is necessary, don't hesitate.
segments.zh: 如果需要暴露后预防，也就是 PEP，不要犹豫。

segments.text: Get it done.
segments.zh: 马上去做。

segments.text: The CDC and OSHA have set the rules for handling biological hazards, and they're not just
segments.zh: CDC 和 OSHA 已经制定了处理生物危害的规则，而这些规则不只是

segments.text: suggestions, they're essential.
segments.zh: 建议，而是必不可少的。

segments.text: The Bloodborne Pathogen Standard makes sure you're following the right steps, from containment
segments.zh: 血源性病原体标准确保你从控制

segments.text: to disposal.
segments.zh: 到处置都遵循正确的步骤。

segments.text: So make sure you're disposing of contaminated materials properly, like using sharps containers
segments.zh: 所以一定要正确处置受污染的材料，比如针头要

segments.text: for needles.
segments.zh: 放进锐器盒。

segments.text: It's all about sticking to the guidelines and keeping everyone safe.
segments.zh: 关键就是要遵守准则，保证每个人的安全。
